behavior: Mobile-only search popup controlled by .header-search-trigger and #mobile-search-popup.
Search data maps keywords to route cards or anchor targets.
Open state uses .is-open, aria-hidden=false and trigger aria-expanded=true.
Close by close button, backdrop click, Escape, or leaving mobile media query.

07-mobile-edge-pad.area: mobile bottom edge handle/scroll home trigger
behavior: Click or upward swipe on .mobile-edge-pad unlocks home scroll and jumps to #more-stories-section.
Edge pad hides when not mobile, when hero is not visible, or when mobile search popup is open.
Uses IntersectionObserver for .hero and MutationObserver for #mobile-search-popup class changes.

08-policy-popup.htmlModule: MODULE 08 — POLICY / LEAVE NO TRACE POLICY MODULE
behavior: .title opens policy popup and is normalized as keyboard-accessible trigger.
Policy popup clones #logoTrigger .mask into .policy-popup-logo-slot when opened.
Policy action closes policy popup then opens #leave-no-trace-popup and checks #leaveNoTraceCheckbox.
Guidelines toggle uses .is-open, aria-hidden and aria-expanded.

couplingNotes: High-coupling node: #leave-no-trace-popup is touched by main.js/initHomePopup, policy-popup.js, booking.js, story-expand.js, gesture.js, tour-carousel.js, navigation.js.
route-handler-overlap-risk: tour-carousel.js handles .popup-note-item[data-tour], navigation.js handles snorkeling card, and tour-card-links.js is an incomplete legacy mapping module.
story-expand.js closes tour popup and scrolls to #more-stories-section; back-to-tours scrolls to .hero.

behavior: Contact popup opens from #logoTrigger or [data-contact-popup-trigger].
Open/close state uses .is-open, aria-hidden, trigger aria-expanded and mobile-popup-scroll-lock.
Closes via close button, backdrop click, Escape, or billy:close-contact-popup event.
Can be opened externally via billy:open-contact-popup event.
main.js/initMobileHomeFeed clones .more-stories-inner content into .mobile-home-feed panels and removes duplicate ids from clones.
main.js/initMobileHomeSectionLock guards mobile/tablet users from scrolling above home section after lock activation.
story-expand.js scrolls from tour popup to #more-stories-section and back-to-tours scrolls to .hero.
mobile-edge-pad.js jumps from hero to more stories on mobile.

20-snorkeling-page.area: snorkeling landing page/back button/video lazy-load/booking modal/prep modal/booking form/swipe back
20-snorkeling-page.htmlModule: coral-snorkeling-phu-quoc.html — snorkeling landing page runtime module
behavior: DOMContentLoaded initializes snorkeling page runtime.
Back button and left-edge swipe return user to index.html.
Booking/prep modals open via data attributes and close via close attributes, backdrop click, or Escape.
Booking date minimum is set to tomorrow.
Package price and submit disabled state are recalculated from guest count and experience type.
Booking submit renders summary into #snorkelingConfirmation.
Hero video lazy load exists but is intentionally disabled to prevent 404 console error.
futureUploadIfBug: related snorkeling CSS file if visual/modal issue appears

21-page-entry-modules.area: secondary landing page JS entries and shared page helper
behavior: hiking.js imports initGesture from ../ui/gesture.js, logs Hiking page loaded, then initializes gesture and page function.
camping.js imports initGesture from ../ui/gesture.js, logs Camping page loaded, then initializes gesture and page function.
general.js exports initGeneralPage(pageName), logs pageName + page loaded, then initializes gesture.

22-payment-confirmation-stubs.area: payment demo and booking confirmation rendering stubs
behavior: payment.js exports initPayment and binds click on #paymentButton if present.
confirmation.js exports showConfirmation(data) and renders name/guest confirmation into #confirmationBox if present.
riskNotes: confirmation.js uses innerHTML with incoming data; sanitize before using untrusted user input.
#paymentButton and #confirmationBox were not found in active index.html inventory, so these files are likely page-specific or not integrated yet.
